per_step.command:
mkdir -p /app/output && echo "# Contract Risk Summary

## Generated on $(date)" > /app/output/risk_summary.md && for contract in /app/contracts/*; do if [ -f "$contract" ]; then echo "
### Analysis for $contract
" >> /app/output/risk_summary.md && /usr/local/bin/analyze_contract.sh "$contract" >> /app/output/risk_summary.md && echo "
---
" >> /app/output/risk_summary.md; fi; done && echo "
## Review Complete" >> /app/output/risk_summary.md
